groups.headline: Your old leads have unfinished business.

variants.label: A1
variants.name: The thaw
variants.description: A single contact card emerges from clear ice. Quiet, cinematic, and focused.

variants.label: A2
variants.name: Second look
variants.description: An overlooked lead is pulled from the archive. Tactile editorial photography.

variants.label: A3
variants.name: Back in motion
variants.description: A dormant card moves toward a new appointment. Bold, sculptural paper illustration.

variants.label: B1
variants.name: The prepared handoff
variants.description: A briefing passes between colleagues. Natural photography and a human moment.

variants.label: B2
variants.name: One continuous conversation
variants.description: A telephone connects to the caller’s details. A clean, architectural still life.

variants.label: B3
variants.name: Context, carried
variants.description: A conversation travels intact to a producer. Crisp editorial paper illustration.
